_doc: Task 05 accident causes (non-graphic, shown as a short collapse and a toast).

accident_drowning.label: Drowning
accident_drowning.text: {name} slipped beneath the water and could not be saved.
accident_drowning.legacy_text: Their life ended by the water.
accident_drowning.child_text: The water took them. I don't want to go near it.

accident_choking.label: Choking
accident_choking.text: {name} could not get their breath back, and no one was there in time.
accident_choking.legacy_text: Their life ended suddenly at the table.
accident_choking.child_text: They were just eating. I don't understand.

memory.text: the sudden quiet at the table

accident_electric.label: Electric shock
accident_electric.text: {name} was hurt by a terrible shock and could not be revived.
accident_electric.legacy_text: Their life ended in a sudden accident.
accident_electric.child_text: It happened so fast. I'm scared of the wires now.

accident_traffic.label: Road accident
accident_traffic.text: {name} was struck on the road and could not be saved.
accident_traffic.legacy_text: Their life ended in a road accident.
accident_traffic.child_text: The road took them. I'm so scared.

accident_fall.label: A fall
accident_fall.text: {name} had a fall and never recovered.
accident_fall.legacy_text: Their life ended after a fall.
accident_fall.child_text: They only slipped. How can that be?

accident_work.label: Accident at work
accident_work.text: {name} was lost in an accident at work.
accident_work.legacy_text: Their life ended in an accident at work.
accident_work.child_text: They went to work and did not come home.

memory.text: the day of the accident at work
